task_completion.description: Navigate to the Quotes module in Vtiger CRM and initiate a new quote creation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Quotes' module open and the 'Add Quote' or 'Create Quote' form displayed.

task_completion.description: Enter the Subject, Organization Name, and Quote Stage correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Subject field shows 'Q-2024-GreenTech-Peripherals', Organization Name shows 'GreenTech Solutions', and Quote Stage is set to 'Created'.

task_completion.description: Set the Valid Until date and the Description field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Valid Until field shows '2025-03-31' and the Description text area contains 'Peripheral equipment quote for GreenTech Solutions Q1 2025 office refresh'.

task_completion.description: Add 25 Wireless Bluetooth Headsets at 49.99 each.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line item for 'Wireless Bluetooth Headset' with quantity '25' and list price '49.99' is visible in the Item Details section.

task_completion.description: Add 10 USB-C Docking Stations at 129.99 each.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line item for 'USB-C Docking Station' with quantity '10' and list price '129.99' is visible in the Item Details section.
A line item for 'Ergonomic Keyboard' with quantity '15' and list price '79.99' is visible in the Item Details section.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM graphical user interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields, dropdowns, and the 'Save' button in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent searched for or selected the organization and products from the CRM's existing database.
integrity.visual_evidence: Pop-up windows or autocomplete dropdowns appearing when the agent types in the Organization or Product fields.

integrity.description: The agent successfully saved the record to ensure it is created in the system.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screen transitions from the 'Edit/Create' view to a 'Detail' view of the saved quote, or a success message is displayed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The quote must have: Subject: 'Q-2024-GreenTech-Peripherals'; Organization: 'GreenTech Solutions'; Stage: 'Created'; Valid Until: '2025-03-31'; Description: 'Peripheral equipment quote for GreenTech Solutions Q1 2025 office refresh'. Line items: 25 Wireless Bluetooth Headsets ($49.99), 10 USB-C Docking Stations ($129.99), and 15 Ergonomic Keyboards ($79.99). The calculated grand total should be 3749.50.
